errors.forbidden: Argo CD does not show this application to the signed-in account.
errors.notFound: Argo CD was not found in this cluster: there is no argocd-server Service.

installation.ambiguous: Several namespaces of this cluster look like an Argo CD installation ({{namespaces}}), and nothing their users cannot create themselves tells which one is real, so Sextant connects to none of them. A cluster-wide Argo CD is recognized by the ClusterRoleBinding of argocd-application-controller or argocd-server; ask the cluster administrator to check it.

login.title: Sign in to Argo CD
login.intro: Sextant could not sign in to Argo CD in {{namespace}} by itself. Sign in with a local user or an API token.
login.expired: The Argo CD session has expired and signing in again with the saved login did not work.
login.noLocalUsers: This Argo CD has no local users who may sign in with a password: use an API token.
login.sso: Sign-in through SSO is not supported in Sextant.
login.hint: Before asking, Sextant tries the saved login, the admin password from argocd-initial-admin-secret and API tokens in Secrets labelled app.kubernetes.io/part-of=argocd. argocd-secret holds only a bcrypt hash of the admin password, so it cannot be used to sign in.

errors.invalid: Argo CD refused the user name or password.
errors.invalidToken: Argo CD refused the API token: it is wrong, expired or revoked.
errors.ssoOnly: This Argo CD signs in only through SSO, which Sextant does not support: use an API token.
errors.unreachable: Argo CD is not reachable: its server has no ready pod or does not answer.
errors.incomplete: Enter a user name and password, or an API token.
errors.other: Signing in to Argo CD did not work.
